title: 安全知识问答：从基本概念到现场设备

author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/01_Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers HSE Officer Interview Questions/src.py

points.K28: 合成纤维扁平吊带颜色代码
points.K29: 吊带的安全工作载荷SWL判断
points.K35: 脚手架的七项预防措施

shots.scene: 欣欣站在面试问答台后，身边亮着一个问号灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium with a glowing question mark lamp beside it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到安全员面试问答！
overlay: 安全知识问答：从基本概念到现场设备

shots.scene: 一排台阶从低到高，台阶上依次是问号、盾牌、烧瓶、安全帽图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of steps rising from low to high, each with an icon: a question mark, a shield, a flask and a hard hat. No people.
shots.narration: 题目由易到难，一题一题来。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着衬衫拿着空白简历，在面试室门口紧张地踱步
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a neat shirt holds a blank resume and paces nervously outside an interview room door.
shots.narration: 阿杰要去应聘工厂的安全员。

shots.scene: 空白卡片散落桌面，上面是三角警示、红十字、碰撞图标
shots.prompt_en: Blank cards scattered on a desk showing a warning triangle icon, a red cross icon and a collision icon, all mixed up. No people.
shots.narration: 面试官会问什么？他心里没底。

shots.scene: 欣欣从问答台后探出身，举起问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot leans out from behind the quiz podium and holds up a blank card with a question mark icon.
shots.narration: 别慌，常考的题我们都过一遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在厂区一角，身旁浮现人、厂房、地球三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a tidy factory yard with three floating icons beside it: a person, a building and a globe.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么是安全？

shots.scene: 人、财产、环境三个图标外罩一层盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person icon, a building icon and a tree icon under one protective shield. No people.
shots.narration: 免于伤人、损物、破坏环境的状态。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向地上乱放的工具和一块锋利的钢板边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at tools scattered on a workshop floor and a sharp steel plate edge sticking out.
shots.narration: 危害：任何可能造成伤害的东西。

shots.scene: 杂乱的过道和锋利边角两个图标，各带黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Two icons each with a yellow warning triangle: a cluttered walkway with boxes and a sharp metal edge. No people.
shots.narration: 比如内务差、锋利的边角。

shots.scene: 草丛里一条蛇的图标，旁边一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon snake icon in grass next to a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 就连一条蛇，也可能是危害。

shots.scene: 手指贴着创可贴的图标和夹板固定的手臂图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a finger with a bandage and an icon of an arm in a splint. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害：事故给身体造成的损害。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着自己贴了创可贴的手指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a small bandage on his finger.
shots.narration: 比如割伤、骨折。

shots.scene: 倒下的货架、冒烟的机器、倒地的小人三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a toppled storage rack, a smoking machine and a fallen person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 事故：没有计划的意外事件。

shots.scene: 财产、环境、人身三个图标上都打了红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A building icon, a tree icon and a person icon, each with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 会损坏财产、环境，甚至致人死亡。

shots.scene: 锤子从高处落下，砸在小人图标旁边的地上
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hammer falling from above and landing on the ground right next to an unharmed person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 未遂事件：锤子掉了，没砸到人。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起食指，神情认真
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger with a serious face.
shots.narration: 关键是：它曾经有伤人的可能。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着天平，一端是骰子图标，一端是爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a balance scale with a dice icon on one side and a small burst icon on the other.
shots.narration: 风险：被危害伤到的可能性。

shots.scene: 骰子图标、乘号、伤害图标组成的算式
shots.prompt_en: A simple equation made of icons: a dice icon, a multiplication sign, an injury icon, an equals sign and a gauge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 也写作：风险等于L乘C。

shots.scene: 五个圆形图标围成一圈：书、奖章、齿轮、法槌、放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Five round icons in a circle: a book, a medal, a gear, a gavel and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 预防事故的5E，是一套安全方案。

shots.scene: 王老师给工人们上培训课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of workers in hard hats in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 教育：通过培训教育工人。

shots.scene: 老周给一名工人颁发奖章
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a medal to a worker in a hard hat, who smiles.
shots.narration: 激励：用奖励鼓励安全行为。

shots.scene: 老李安装机器防护罩，旁边是规章文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a guard on a machine next to a shelf with blank rule binders.
shots.narration: 工程控制，再用规章落实安全计划。

shots.scene: 放大镜图标扫过一张打勾的清单
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon moves over a blank checklist with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 第五个E，是评估。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔分五层，从上到下颜色由绿到红
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid divided into five colored layers from green at the top to red at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 控制层级：减少或消除危害的体系。

shots.scene: 危险物品图标被划掉，换成较温和的物品图标
shots.prompt_en: A drum with a skull pictogram is crossed out and replaced by a drum with a milder warning pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 先消除，再替代，然后工程控制。

shots.scene: 王老师递出一张空白作业许可证
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a blank work permit form to the young male student.
shots.narration: 管理控制：安全工作制度和作业许可。

shots.scene: 安全帽、护目镜、手套、安全鞋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hard hat, safety goggles, gloves and safety boots. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一级，是个人防护装备。

shots.scene: 杂乱的工作台变得整洁的前后对比
shots.prompt_en: A before-and-after view: a messy workbench on the left and the same bench neat and organized on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 5S让工作场所整洁有序。

shots.scene: 阿杰把坏工具和不用的设备搬进回收箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts broken tools and unused equipment into a collection bin.
shots.narration: 整理：清走损坏和不用的工具设备。

shots.scene: 小研把工具挂回轮廓板，再擦干净台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs tools back on a shadow board and then wipes the bench clean.
shots.narration: 整顿归位，清扫干净。

shots.scene: 墙上贴着空白检查表，打满绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist on the wall filled with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 定出标准，持之以恒。

shots.scene: 老周在空白承诺书上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank commitment document at his desk.
shots.narration: HSE方针：最高管理层的书面承诺。

shots.scene: 承诺书图标上方是心形和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank document icon with a heart icon and a shield icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 承诺照顾员工工作中的健康与安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白标准文本，封面只有一个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank standard booklet with only a simple emblem icon on the cover.

shots.scene: 三张空白卡片依次亮起：靶心、人像、齿轮
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards light up one by one: a target icon, a person icon and a gear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 总体声明、职责、安排三部分。

shots.scene: 空白计划书从承诺书图标中延伸出来
shots.prompt_en: A blank plan booklet extends from a commitment document icon with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: HSE计划：实现方针承诺的计划。

shots.scene: 小研在每张任务卡旁贴上危害标记和对策卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pins hazard markers and blank control cards next to each task card on a board.
shots.narration: 识别每项任务的危害，配上控制措施。

shots.scene: 一群戴安全帽的工人图标外罩盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A group of worker pictograms in hard hats under a protective shield. No people.
shots.narration: 目的是保障员工的安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一本空白操作规程手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank procedure manual with numbered step icons.
shots.narration: SOP：一套书面的操作指令。

shots.scene: 规程手册上步骤一二三的图标，旁边是危险作业图标
shots.prompt_en: A manual open to step icons one, two and three, next to an icon of a hazardous task with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 详细写明危险作业怎样安全完成。

shots.scene: 阿杰照着配电柜旁的空白规程卡逐步操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows a blank step card posted next to an electrical panel, checking each step.
shots.narration: 比如电气作业，就照电气SOP做。

shots.scene: 五级台阶图标，每级一个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five stairs, each with an icon: a magnifying glass, a group of people, a scale, a notepad and a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估，分五步。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰围着空白评估表讨论
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student discuss a blank assessment form at a workbench.
shots.narration: 先识别危害，再想谁会受伤、怎么伤。

shots.scene: 表格上逐行打勾，配控制措施图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank form with rows getting check marks, and control icons appearing beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 评估风险并行动，把发现记录下来。

shots.scene: 日历图标和循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a circular arrow around it. No people.
shots.narration: 第五步：回顾。

shots.scene: 放大镜对准一张事故示意图
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a simple diagram of a fallen ladder and a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 事故调查的目的有三条。

shots.scene: 树根图标、扳手图标、法规书图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: tree roots, a wrench and a law book. No people.
shots.narration: 查根本原因，定纠正措施，满足法律。

shots.scene: 分数线图标：上面是事故图标乘大数，下面是时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A fraction made of icons: an accident icon times a big number above the line and a clock icon below the line. No people.
shots.narration: 频率率：损失工时事故数乘一百万。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着空白板上的算式图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank board with simple equation icons.
shots.narration: 再除以总工时。

shots.scene: 两个事故图标，一个时钟图标，等号后一个大号数字牌
shots.prompt_en: Two accident icons, a clock icon and an equals sign followed by a large blank number card. No people.
shots.narration: 2起事故、一百万工时，结果是2。

shots.scene: 分数线图标：上面是日历图标，下面是时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A fraction made of icons: a calendar icon with crossed days above the line and a clock icon below. No people.
shots.narration: 严重率：损失工作日乘一百万。

shots.scene: 日历上划掉七天，等号后一个大号数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with seven days crossed out, an equals sign and a large blank number card. No people.
shots.narration: 7个工作日、一百万工时，结果是7。

shots.scene: 会议桌两边人数相等，中间是安全盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A meeting table with equal numbers of seats on each side and a shield icon in the middle; the older man and the young male student sit across from each other.
shots.narration: 安全委员会：工人代表和管理层一起开。

shots.scene: 王老师主持会议，大家在空白议程上讨论
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads a meeting; the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student discuss a blank agenda.
shots.narration: 会议专门讨论安全问题。

shots.scene: 天平两边各站同样多的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with the same number of person pictograms on each side, perfectly level. No people.
shots.narration: 按印度1948年工厂法第41G条，人数相等。

shots.scene: 左边望远镜图标，右边后视镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A telescope icon on the left and a rear-view mirror icon on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 安全绩效指标，分先行和滞后两类。

shots.scene: 培训图标和检查清单图标
shots.prompt_en: A training class icon and a checklist icon with an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 先行指标：主动监测，培训和检查次数。

shots.scene: 事故图标和病假图标
shots.prompt_en: An accident icon and a sick-leave bed icon with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 滞后指标：被动监测，事故率和病缺。

shots.scene: 空气中漂浮的小分子点，旁边一个小人图标和日历
shots.prompt_en: Small floating molecule dots in the air next to a person pictogram and a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: TLV，阈限值：空气中有害物浓度。

shots.scene: 小人图标在一条长时间线上走过
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram walking along a long timeline from young to old, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 日复一日接触一辈子，也不伤健康。

shots.scene: 时钟图标显示八小时，日历显示一周五天
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon showing a full working day and a calendar icon with five weekdays highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: TWA：每天8小时、每周40小时。

shots.scene: 波动的浓度曲线，下面一条平均线
shots.prompt_en: A wavy concentration line with a flat average line drawn under it. No people.
shots.narration: 这样接触，长短期都不伤健康。

shots.scene: 气体分子图标旁一个大号数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A gas molecule icon next to a large blank number card. No people.
shots.narration: 以硫化氢为例，TWA是10ppm。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁一个浓度尖峰
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a short sharp peak on a concentration line. No people.
shots.narration: STEL：最多接触15分钟的最高浓度。

shots.scene: 气体分子图标旁一个大号数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A gas molecule icon next to a large blank number card with an hourglass. No people.
shots.narration: 硫化氢的STEL是15ppm。

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH
shots.scene: 红色警示区里的骷髅图标，小人图标被红光笼罩
shots.prompt_en: A red danger zone with a skull pictogram and a person pictogram at its edge bathed in red light. No people.
shots.narration: IDLH：一接触就直接威胁生命。
overlay: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH

shots.section_title: 立即威胁生命和健康浓度IDLH
shots.scene: 气体分子图标旁一个大号红色数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A gas molecule icon next to a large red blank number card. No people.
shots.narration: 硫化氢的IDLH是100ppm。

shots.scene: 液体表面冒出蒸气，靠近火花时一闪
shots.prompt_en: Vapor rises from the surface of a liquid in an open dish; a spark nearby makes a brief flash. No people.
shots.narration: 闪点：蒸气遇火源能点燃的最低温度。

shots.scene: 柴油桶图标旁一个温度计
shots.prompt_en: A diesel drum icon next to a thermometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 比如柴油，闪点是54摄氏度。

shots.scene: 闪一下的火焰变成持续燃烧的火焰，旁边秒表
shots.prompt_en: A brief flash above a liquid turns into a steady flame that keeps burning, a stopwatch beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 燃点：点着后至少持续烧5秒的温度。

shots.scene: 两个温度计，第二个略高
shots.prompt_en: Two thermometer icons side by side, the second slightly higher than the first, next to a diesel drum icon. No people.
shots.narration: 燃点高于闪点，柴油是57摄氏度。

shots.scene: 热表面上的容器自己冒出火苗，周围没有火源
shots.prompt_en: A closed container on a very hot surface bursts into flame by itself with no spark or flame nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 自燃点：没有外部火源也会自己着火。

shots.scene: 柴油桶图标旁一个很高的温度计
shots.prompt_en: A diesel drum icon next to a thermometer icon with a very high reading. No people.
shots.narration: 柴油的自燃点是256摄氏度。

shots.scene: 卡通消防员拿水枪灭火，旁边一个红色消防栓
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon firefighter sprays water at a fire with a hose connected to a red outdoor fire hydrant. No people besides the firefighter.
shots.narration: 消防栓：消防员接水带取水的接口。

shots.scene: 六个消防栓图标排成两行
shots.prompt_en: Six fire hydrant icons arranged in two rows. No people.
shots.narration: 消防栓分六种。

shots.scene: 消防栓剖面图标，栓体充满蓝色水，上方太阳图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway icon of a hydrant with its barrel filled with blue water, under a sun icon. No people.
shots.narration: 湿式：栓体里充水，用在炎热地区。

shots.scene: 消防栓剖面图标，栓体是空的，上方雪花图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway icon of a hydrant with an empty barrel, under a snowflake icon. No people.
shots.narration: 干式：栓体不充水，寒冷地区防结冰。

shots.scene: 带阀门手轮的消防栓和没有手轮的消防栓
shots.prompt_en: Two hydrant icons: one with a valve wheel and one without a valve wheel. No people.
shots.narration: 可控式能用阀门控水，不可控式不能。

shots.scene: 两个出水口和三个出水口的消防栓
shots.prompt_en: Two hydrant icons: one with two outlets and one with three outlets. No people.
shots.narration: 按出水口数量，分二通和三通。

shots.section_title: 合成纤维扁平吊带颜色代码
shots.scene: 一排不同颜色的扁平吊带
shots.prompt_en: A row of flat lifting slings in different solid colors: violet, green, yellow, grey and red. No people.
shots.narration: 吊带颜色代表吨数：紫1绿2黄3。
overlay: 合成纤维扁平吊带颜色代码

shots.section_title: 合成纤维扁平吊带颜色代码
shots.scene: 另一排吊带：棕、蓝、橙
shots.prompt_en: Another row of flat lifting slings in brown, blue and orange. No people.
shots.narration: 灰4红5，棕6蓝8，橙色10吨以上。

shots.section_title: 吊带的安全工作载荷SWL判断
shots.scene: 黄色吊带，空白标签被放大镜放大
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass enlarges a blank tag sewn onto a yellow sling. No people.
shots.narration: 判断载荷：看颜色，看标签。
overlay: 吊带的安全工作载荷SWL判断

shots.section_title: 吊带的安全工作载荷SWL判断
shots.scene: 吊带上三条黑色条纹逐条亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three black stripes woven along a sling light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 还能数黑条纹，一条代表1吨。

shots.scene: D形卸扣和弓形卸扣并排
shots.prompt_en: Two plain metal shackles side by side: a D-shaped shackle and a bow-shaped shackle. No people.
shots.narration: 起重卸扣两种：D形和弓形。

shots.scene: 卸扣线图，各部位依次高亮
shots.prompt_en: A simple line drawing of a bow shackle with its parts highlighted one by one: crown, bow, pin head, jaw, ear, pin and shoulder. No people.
shots.narration: 部件：弓顶、弓身、销头、开口。

shots.scene: 线图继续高亮耳部、销轴和肩部
shots.prompt_en: The same line drawing now highlights the ears, the pin and the shoulder. No people.
shots.narration: 还有耳、销轴和肩部。

shots.scene: 放大镜照着卸扣表面空白的铭刻区
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over the blank stamped marking area on a plain shackle. No people.
shots.narration: 卸扣上刻有工作载荷极限和角度。

shots.scene: 放大镜移到卸扣另一侧
shots.prompt_en: The magnifying glass moves to the other side of the plain shackle, with a green check stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有制造商、直径、批号和检验标记。

shots.scene: 建筑外搭着的脚手架，平台上放着工具箱
shots.prompt_en: A metal scaffold built against a building wall, with a toolbox on the platform. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架：临时的高处工作平台。

shots.scene: 平台上方有人、材料、工具三个图标，旁边高度标尺
shots.prompt_en: Above the scaffold platform float three icons: a person, a stack of materials and a toolbox, with a height ruler beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 1.8米以上作业时支撑人、料、工具。

shots.scene: 五个警示图标：人坠落、物坠落、架子倒塌、梯子缺失、电线
shots.prompt_en: Five warning icons in a row: a falling person, a falling object, a collapsing scaffold, a missing ladder and an overhead power line. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架有五种危害。

shots.scene: 架子倒塌图标和架空电线图标加红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A collapsing scaffold icon and an overhead power line icon, each with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 人和物会坠落，架子会倒，还有电线。

shots.section_title: 脚手架的七项预防措施
shots.scene: 全身式安全带、生命线、锚点三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a full-body harness, a lifeline rope and an anchor point. No people.
shots.narration: 一，用合适的个人坠落防护系统。
overlay: 脚手架的七项预防措施

shots.section_title: 脚手架的七项预防措施
shots.scene: 带上横杆、中横杆、踢脚板的护栏示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a scaffold guardrail with a top rail, a mid rail and a toe board, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 平台不放松散物料，护栏要完善。

shots.section_title: 脚手架的七项预防措施
shots.scene: 坚实地基上的脚手架和标准材料图标
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold standing on firm base plates with a green check next to a standard material icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用合格标准材料，地基要牢固。

shots.section_title: 脚手架的七项预防措施
shots.scene: 老李带工人搭脚手架，旁边梯子通道和远离电线的箭头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer guides a worker assembling a scaffold, with a ladder access and an arrow keeping distance from a power line.
shots.narration: 能力人员搭设，设通道，远离电线。

shots.scene: 高空升降平台、吊椅、悬链式脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an aerial lift platform, a hanging seat on ropes and a platform hung on a stretched wire. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架十种：高空升降、吊椅、悬链。

shots.scene: 爬行板、浮式、梯架式脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a crawling board on a roof, a floating platform hung under a beam and a ladder jack scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 爬行板、浮式、梯架式。

shots.scene: 针梁式、自给可调式脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a needle beam scaffold and a self-contained adjustable scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 针梁式、自给可调式。

shots.scene: 单点、两点悬挂式和落地支撑式脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a platform suspended by one and two ropes, and a ground-supported frame scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 单点两点悬挂式，还有支撑式。

shots.scene: 高处平台边的护栏和安全带图标，旁边高度标尺
shots.prompt_en: A high platform edge icon with a guardrail and a harness icon beside it, and a height ruler. No people.
shots.narration: OSHA 1926.451：10英尺以上要防坠。

shots.scene: 交叉支撑的交点兼作上横杆，旁边高度范围箭头
shots.prompt_en: Cross bracing on a scaffold where the cross point serves as a top rail, with a height range arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 交叉点作上横杆，须在38到48英寸。

shots.scene: 脚手架上的大砝码图标，旁边是4倍；悬挂平台旁是6倍
shots.prompt_en: A large weight icon on a scaffold with a multiplier sign, and a suspended platform with a bigger multiplier sign. No people.
shots.narration: 至少承受4倍最大载荷，悬挂式6倍。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现危害、风险、事故、未遂四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating icons: a warning triangle, a gauge, a collision and a near-miss arrow.
shots.narration: 基本概念：危害、风险、事故、未遂。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔、5S和五级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid icon, a tidy bench icon and a five-step stair icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 5E、控制层级、5S、风险评估五步。

shots.scene: 方针、计划、SOP、指标图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a commitment document, a plan booklet, a procedure manual and a bar chart. No people.
shots.narration: 方针、计划、SOP和各项安全指标。

shots.scene: 温度计、气体分子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a thermometer and floating gas molecules. No people.
shots.narration: 接触限值，和闪点、燃点、自燃点。

shots.scene: 消防栓、吊带、卸扣、脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fire hydrant, a lifting sling, a shackle and a scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 还有消防栓、吊带、卸扣和脚手架。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台后鼓掌，阿杰竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot claps behind the quiz podium while the young male student gives a thumbs up, then both wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 祝你面试顺利，我们下期见！
